edition: Fixed LanguageTool6.6 CLI, synthetic-only output-minimizing probe

boundaries: Canary text in sentence/context/messages/replacements/extra fields excluded from projected report
Invalid JSON/version/rule IDs/out-of-range spans rejected without raw content
JVM injection rejected before artifact access; no option value disclosure
Cleanup path guard rejects parent/outside/arbitrary directories

limits: Only the two named executable/JAR files pinned; other runtime/library/resource/config contents not fully verified.
No OS network denial, traffic capture or runtime exporter/config attestation.
Raw child text exists transiently in memory; no secure memory erasure, crash dump, swap, terminal history or system-retention guarantee.
Recursive cleanup is restricted to the newly created temp directory; prior experiment inputs/logs and user files are not erased.
Custom/native code or external mechanisms can write outside the intended directories; no complete write audit.
This probe accepts fixed synthetic cases only. It is not a real-document editor or a generally approved privacy tool.
Counts/offsets are derived data, not a universal de-identification guarantee. No full accuracy/license/rights qualification.
decision: Reproducible synthetic summary boundary validated; privacy candidate remains unqualified.
ownerAction: Run the new pure Node tests and receipt checks when applying; Java probe is optional and not needed to submit this packet.
